import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import xgb

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = "./input/sample_submission.csv"

# Setup submission directory
if not os.path.exists(SUBMISSION_DIR):
    os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# Define target and ID columns
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"

# Feature extraction - exclude Id and target from features
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != id_col and col != target_col]

# Prepare Training Data
X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train_full = train_df[target_col].copy()

# Split into train/validation WITHOUT stratification (since some classes have too few samples)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Initialize XGBoost Classifier
clf = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    use_label_encoder=False,
    eval_metric="multi_logloss",
    max_depth=6,
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    verbosity=0,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
)

# Fit Model ONLY on training data (not including validation)
clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Evaluate on Hold-Out Validation Set (Internal Metric) - NEVER refit on this
val_preds = clf.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(val_accuracy)

# Generate Predictions on Test Set (unlabeled data)
test_feature_data = test_df[[c for c in test_df.columns if c != id_col]]
test_preds = clf.predict(test_feature_data)

# Create submission DataFrame matching sample_submission format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {id_col: test_df[id_col], target_col: test_preds.astype(int)}
)

# Save submission file to required path
submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
